verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
This yearning deep within me
Reaches out to you

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your oil of joy for mourning
Soaks me, makes me new

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
And I will go to Your secret place
Bow my knee to Your glorious throne

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Have Your way in my heart O Lord
Have Your way

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I need Your Holy Spirit
Fire to my soul

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Consume my total being
Jesus take control

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Have Your way
Have Your way
Have Your way
